title: Senior intelligence official and his wife abducted

tellings.quote: Anecdotally, I know of one extremely senior intelligence official who had a pretty gnarly abduction experience along with his wife.
Jim Seivian comes out and blatantly openly talks about a kind of an abduction experience
tellings.difference: Names the official as Jim Semivan of the CIA and says he talks about it openly.
tellings.link_reason: A senior intelligence official and his wife sharing an abduction experience. This is the same account Michels gave without the name.

as_told.title: Jim Semivan and his wife's abduction experience

tellings.quote: he had experiences of entities in his room with with his wife and they were not pleasant experiences

tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the senior intelligence official Jim Semivan having unpleasant or abduction-type entity experiences together with his wife.

as_told.title: Jim Semivan's unpleasant entity experiences with his wife

plain: A very senior American intelligence official and his wife are said to have had a frightening encounter with non-human beings. Michels tells it first without naming him, as a "pretty gnarly abduction experience" he knows of from someone he does not name. A researcher named Peter Levenda names the man as Jim Semivan of the CIA and says Semivan talks openly about "a kind of an abduction experience". A CIA contractor named Bob McGwier, who says he knows Semivan, puts it differently: Semivan "had experiences of entities in his room" with his wife, and "they were not pleasant". If true, it would mean such encounters reach people deep inside the intelligence world.
